paths_reviewed.review_notes: The only candidate-relative change removes the pnpm-lock.yaml ignore rule and replaces it with an explanatory comment. origin/main tracks pnpm-lock.yaml; the shared checkout also tracks it. The policy makes new/modified pnpm lockfiles visible in an isolated checkout.

The Vitest contract asserts the root lockfile is tracked, copies the current ignore file into a temporary repository, verifies a new lockfile appears as untracked and is not ignored, then verifies an edited tracked lockfile appears modified. All temporary repository operations are under os.tmpdir() and rmSync(..., {recursive:true, force:true}) runs in finally.

boundary_review.portability_limit: The temporary repository does not override inherited global Git excludes or hook configuration, and subprocesses have no explicit timeout. A user-level core.excludesFile or core.hooksPath could make the fixture environment-dependent; none affected this run.

findings_and_limits.observation: The focused contract passed and checks the two important Git states: a new lockfile is visible as untracked, and a changed tracked lockfile is visible as modified.
The scratch repository inherits global Git excludes and hooks instead of explicitly disabling them. The current run passed, but the fixture is not fully hermetic across developer machines.

candidate_actions: Keep the pnpm lockfile visible to Git and preserve its tracked state.
